verdict: Ads have been dark for 17 days; relaunch is in motion now.
narrative: All paid activity stopped on September 17, meaning no new leads have been generated in the last 17 days — the 48 leads and $16.20 cost per lead reported this period came entirely from the days before that pause. Before ads can safely restart, eight setup milestones (conversion tracking, landing pages, audience infrastructure, and creative) need to be completed and verified; that work is underway now. Google Ads spent $201 this period and returned zero measurable conversions, so that budget is being held until tracking is confirmed. Separately, the 82 contacts already in your pipeline have not yet converted to appointments or won opportunities, and we're addressing the follow-up process in parallel with the relaunch. Once the foundation is verified and ads are back on, you should see lead flow resume — optimizing toward actual activations is the goal for the rest of October.

highlights.phrase: leads received this period, all before the 17-day pause — none since September 17
cost per lead on Meta when ads were running this period
open pipeline contacts with zero appointments booked — follow-up is being tightened

watch_item.issue: Ads are dark and Google spend returned zero conversions this period, compounding the lead drought.
watch_item.fix: Eight overdue setup items — including conversion tracking, landing pages, and audience infrastructure — are being completed this week so paid campaigns can relaunch on a verified foundation.
